summary: Hafnia Limited, a Singapore-domiciled NYSE/Oslo-listed tanker operator, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a direct placement of 35,488,875 ordinary shares at $8.43 (NOK 80.00) per share, grossing about $299.1 million. Fearnley and Pareto acted as joint global coordinators; Clarksons and Arctic as joint bookrunners, with 2.50% cash plus 0.75% incentive fees. Delivery is expected on or about September 28, 2026. This is an ordinary marketed equity follow-on, not a special situation; watch dilution and any share-lending overhang.
